info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Trade Banking By Factoring Id-spec
info.description: The Trade Banking Factoring Update API allows businesses to modify existing trade banking transactions identified by a unique factoring ID. This API streamlines the process of updating relevant details such as financial terms, status, and documentation linked to a specific factoring transaction. Typical consumers include trade finance managers and banking professionals who need to maintain accurate and up-to-date records in their financial systems. Through this API, users can ensure that their records align with the latest business developments, enhancing operational efficiency and service delivery.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of the specified factoring resource identified by its unique ID. Ensure all necessary fields are included in the request to execute the update successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the factoring information for the specified resource. It should contain the necessary fields to modify the existing details according to the application's business logic.
